## Conveyor Belt Sushi: Sushiro

Sushiro is one of Japan's largest conveyor belt sushi chains.

Located in the center of Shibuya's shopping area, Sushiro is perfect for enjoying affordable sushi when you get hungry after shopping in Shibuya.

Each counter seat is equipped with an electronic tablet, allowing customers to order everything from a multilingual menu. [...] ## Uobei: Entertaining Sushi Delivered by High-Speed Conveyor Lane

Uobei adds a futuristic twist to conveyor belt sushi. Instead of plates rotating around, customers order from a multilingual touchscreen, and freshly made sushi is delivered directly to their seats via a high-speed mini conveyor lane. This entertaining and efficient dining experience is especially recommended for families. [...] The menu changes seasonally, ensuring fresh seafood. During busy times, long queues form, so it is recommended to visit early.

results.content: Uobei Shibuya Dogenzaka Store is a bustling sushi haven that takes dining to the next level with its innovative technology. Here, patrons are seated in a long row and place their orders using convenient buttons. The excitement builds as miniature trains deliver fresh sushi directly to your table, creating an engaging experience for diners of all ages. While the menu features familiar dishes found throughout Tokyo, Uobei stands out for its unique serving method and vibrant atmosphere.
